basis: Balances and plan states are as recorded in the Linear credits ledger on 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-06. Not re-verified in any vendor console. Re-check a balance before a paid run that depends on it.
rules: Credits are a temporary subsidy, not permission to raise spending caps.
Cheapest lane that passes QA wins. A free lane (Remotion kit, Lottie, hand-drawn SVG, Playwright capture) beats any paid lane for the same need.
Azure first (MahumTech resource mt-foundary-resource). Other providers are fallbacks or specialist lanes.
ElevenLabs only through governed_elevenlabs.py. Speech only. No voice clone of the owner.
Higgsfield, Runway and Google Vertex spend stays frozen until the owner approves it in the current task. The funded generative-video lane is IrukaDark (approved hero shots only).
Local AI is off on this PC: no local models, TTS, STT or embedders. Self-hosted models on cloud GPUs are allowed inside the compute caps.
The owner picks the entity each film is made for and uses whatever credit fits. Name the identity in the quote; never stop on ownership.
Do not introduce a provider merely because a key or a startup credit exists for it.

Every lane is exposed to the agent, including by-hand ones: run route_media.py --catalog to see all of them with their mode (script, api, connector or browser) and status. A browser lane is driven through Claude in Chrome on the owner's already signed-in session; never enter credentials or card details, ask before each download, and judge the file before it is accepted.
A frozen lane is listed with what would unfreeze it. Frozen means the owner has not approved that spend in this task, not that the capability is hidden.
Anything marked draftOnly is research or a rough pass. It is never the delivered picture or voice.

lanes.cost: IrukaDark credit, 12,568 credits left after one test clip (12,800 read from Settings > Plans & Billing on 2026-11-06; the F6S 10k code is already redeemed, plan label still Free). A 5 s 720p Seedance 2.5 clip with audio costs 232 credits, so about 54 more clips.
lanes.how: Driven by hand through the signed-in Chrome (Claude in Chrome), never an API: nothing in the app exposes one. Pages: https://irukadark.com/ai/video (Seedance 2.5, 5s, 16:9, 720p, audio on), https://irukadark.com/ai/image, and the Audio and Screenplay entries in the sidebar. Write the prompt from the scene's visual.prompt, generate one clip, look at it, then download it into <jobRoot>/assets/clips/ (ask before each download) and set visual.src. Append the credits spent to qa/spend-ledger.jsonl. Read skills/generate/references/irukadark.md.
lanes.notes: The credit sits on the abacare.ai Google login; the owner picks the entity per film, so name it in the quote and never stop on it. A free-plan balance can change without notice, so read the credit counter again before a run of clips. Approved hero shots only, one shot at a time, never a bulk run. Output is a generated clip: no real people, no logos, no claims about a real product. Verified by one real clip on 2026-11-06: 232 credits charged exactly (12,800 to 12,568), about 4 minutes to render, a 5 s 720p clip of a truck at a dawn dock with the prompt followed. Only the thumbnail frame was inspected, not a playback, and the file was not downloaded, so judge motion and audio on the downloaded file before accepting any clip. It stays conditional because it is by hand and slow.

lanes.cost: Runware credit, the same $252.00 balance as runware-image (2026-11-04). Models are billed per second; the provider's price schema for alibaba-wan3-0 lists $0.05, $0.10 and $0.20 per second at 480p, 720p and 1080p (read from runware.ai/docs/models/<model>/schema.json, free to read).
lanes.how: Runware inference API, taskType videoInference, with RUNWARE_API_KEY from the environment, the same key generate_stills.py uses. Read the model's schema JSON for its price and inputs first, request includeCost, and cap the spend at the quote. There is no wrapper script yet, so write one on the generate_stills.py pattern (quote by default, cache by content hash, ledger line per clip) before a run.
lanes.notes: UNTESTED: no video request has been made to Runware. Approved hero shots only. Runware credits are separate from the frozen Higgsfield and Runway balances. Image-to-video from an accepted still is the safest first test, because it keeps the look the film already has.
